proposals.action_title: Publish First KDP Coloring Book via Runware PAYG
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline is ready. By allocating 5 EUR of the 20 EUR budget to Runware PAYG, Hugo can generate 1,000+ high-quality FLUX-schnell coloring pages, bypass GitHub Actions IP bans, and list a premium 50-page coloring book immediately.
proposals.first_action_today: Register a Runware account, get the API key, deposit 5 EUR, and run the produce_coloring_book workflow with the Runware model.

proposals.action_title: Upload 50 Minimalist Typographic Designs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Text-only designs (funny quotes, local expressions, niche developer jokes) require zero image-generation APIs. They bypass all GPU bottlenecks, render perfectly via Python/Pillow in GitHub Actions, and sell reliably on t-shirts and mugs.
proposals.first_action_today: Run a modified produce_quotes_minimal workflow to generate 50 transparent PNGs of viral developer quotes using custom fonts.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D is highly receptive to functional, parametric designs (e.g., custom organizers, gridfinity accessories, IKEA replacement parts). Using the 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline via OpenSCAD (which runs easily in GitHub Actions headless mode), Hugo can generate STL files without a 3D modeling GUI.
proposals.first_action_today: Configure GitHub Actions to compile 5 variations of a parametric drawer organizer using OpenSCAD and push them to a release folder.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content interiors (graph paper, hex grids for organic chemistry, music staff sheets) require no image generation. Using the 'produce_lowcontent_kdp' pipeline, PDF interiors can be built instantly using Python ReportLab on GitHub Actions, needing only a simple text-based cover.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the low-content pipeline to generate a 120-page Hexagonal Graph Paper interior tailored for chemistry students.

proposals.action_title: List a Gamedev Asset Pack (UI/Icons) on itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers constantly buy 2D pixel art or UI icon packs. By testing Together AI's free tier (FLUX-schnell) or Cloudflare's free Workers AI, Hugo can generate 100 retro RPG item icons, package them into a zip, and sell them for $2.99.
proposals.first_action_today: Verify the TOGETHER_API_KEY inside GitHub Actions and run a test script to generate a single 512x512 fantasy sword icon.

proposals.action_title: Reactivate and Package SVG Cut Files for Cricut
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'produce_svg_pack' pipeline can output clean vector files. SVG bundles (e.g., silhouette animal shapes, holiday designs) have high conversion rates on Etsy. Using 40 free listing codes for a new Etsy shop keeps this 100% free.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 10 clean vector SVG silhouettes using Gemini to write raw SVG XML code directly, bypassing image generation issues.
